# Suryanshu Verma

> Suryanshu Verma is a computer engineer from Nepal who builds verifiable blockchain systems, backend services and full-stack MERN applications. His paper on a modular multi-contract Ethereum framework for pharmaceutical supply-chain traceability was accepted for oral presentation at ICTDsC 2026 (November 19–20, 2026). He is open to backend engineering, blockchain development, freelance and product-focused opportunities.

## Research

- [Design and Evaluation of a Modular Multi-Contract Blockchain Framework for Pharmaceutical Supply Chain Traceability](https://www.suryanshuverma.com.np/#research): Accepted for oral presentation at ICTDsC 2026, Paper ID 162. Authors: Suryanshu Verma, Shreejal Bista, Suman Yadav, Subarna Shakya. Splits an Ethereum framework into three smart contracts (UserRegistry, BatchRegistry, ProductRegistry) and stores only integrity-sensitive fields on-chain. Results — Sepolia testnet: 50/50 benchmarked transactions confirmed, 7.03–24.57 s confirmation; local Hardhat: under 4 ms mean latency per core operation, 179.08 tx/s at 2,000 batches, 8/8 security validation tests passed.
- [PharmaTrace implementation](https://github.com/suryanshuverma0/PharmaTrace): Source code behind the paper.

## Projects

- [Detection of Counterfeit Pharmaceutical Products Using Blockchain](https://www.suryanshuverma.com.np/projects/pharmaceutical-supply-chain-blockchain): Ethereum supply-chain platform with batch registration, shipment tracking, QR-based product verification and role-based access for manufacturers, distributors, pharmacists, admins and consumers.
